## Summary
- Briefly describe what changed and why.

## Screenshots / Recordings
- Add before/after for UI changes (mobile + desktop).

## Responsive QA Checklist
- [ ] Tested at `320px`
- [ ] Tested at `375px`
- [ ] Tested at `768px`
- [ ] Tested at `1024px`
- [ ] Tested at `1280px`
- [ ] Tested on at least one physical phone
- [ ] Navigation works (drawer/sidebar, back/forward, active links)
- [ ] Forms are usable (inputs visible, keyboard does not hide critical controls)
- [ ] Chat is usable (panels stack on mobile, messages do not overflow, input remains usable)
- [ ] Tickets pages are usable (list/detail readable and scroll-safe)
- [ ] No horizontal overflow on main pages
- [ ] Tap targets are comfortable (roughly 44px minimum for key actions)

## Performance Checks
- [ ] Route loads feel acceptable on mobile network/device
- [ ] No obvious render jank during scrolling or typing
- [ ] Any new heavy UI is lazy-loaded or justified

## Risks / Follow-ups
- Note any known limitations, tradeoffs, or next steps.
